mostWorthwhile.text: Building the cochlea was most worthwhile: the picture showed movement bending the hair bundles, and the explanation connected that movement to signals in nerve fibers.

leastWorthwhile.text: The failed attempt to connect the ears directly to the cochlear chambers was frustrating because the need to assemble the inner ear first wasn't clear.

surprise.text: I was surprised that the obvious-looking connection wasn't available until the cochlea had its hair cells and membranes assembled.

arbitrary.text: The assembly prerequisite felt a little arbitrary at first: the bones already led toward the inner ear, but the game didn't explain why the chambers couldn't be connected yet.

continue.text: Yes, I'd try another chapter. Connecting the vibration route to cells and then to the brain was satisfying, though I'd hope prerequisites were clearer.
